subject: OpenGarden holiday maintainer bounty pool — promotional credits request
messages:
From: Samir Khan <samir@opengarden.dev>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Proposal: maintainer bounty pool for OpenGarden holiday hackathon

Hi Karthik,

Hope you’re well — I’m Samir, one of the maintainers/organizers for OpenGarden. We’re running a community-focused hackathon/hardening sprint the week of Dec 6 and want to set up a small bounty pool to pay maintainers and reward quality contributions. Historically we’ve struggled to cover compute/testing costs for maintainers who triage and land external PRs.

Quick ask: would Redwood consider sponsoring a promotional credit pool we can distribute to selected maintainers (open-source contributors) to put toward Redwood Dedicated or sandbox projects? We’re thinking of a $5,000 USD pool that would be split across ~10–12 maintainers for small stipends ($300–500) plus a $1,500 prize pool for top contributions. We’d also need a short trial extension for the OpenGarden org account to allow recipients to use credits across longer-running test jobs.

I’ve attached a short plan (opengarden-hackathon-bounty-plan.pdf) with event timing and proposed recipient criteria. We can be flexible with how the credits are issued (single promo codes per recipient or org-level credit codes).

Would love to know what info you need to move this forward (PO/contract, billing contact, limits on usage, expirations). Open to a quick call this week if useful.

Thanks — Samir
Samir Khan
OpenGarden
maintainers@opengarden.dev

Attachments:
- opengarden-hackathon-bounty-plan.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Samir Khan <samir@opengarden.dev>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-02T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: maintainer bounty pool for OpenGarden holiday hackathon

Samir — thanks for the write-up and the plan. This is exactly the kind of community support we want to pilot in Q4. Looping in Marissa (partnerships) and Vanessa (community) to confirm budget and operational details. A couple quick clarifying Qs from our side:

- Do you want the pool as individual promo codes per maintainer, or one org-level promo code that you distribute?
- Are recipients required to create Dedicated instances, or are credits intended to cover hosted usage as well?
- Do you have a shortlist of the ~10–12 recipients or will you pick after the sprint?

If that’s all good I’ll put this through for approval against our community/promo budget. Marissa — any constraints on expiration (typical is 90 days) or a minimum redemption threshold?

If easier, happy to take a 20-minute call tomorrow.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions, Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-04T14:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: maintainer bounty pool for OpenGarden holiday hackathon

Thanks for the tag, Karthik. Reviewed the attached plan. We can approve a $5,000 promotional credit allocation from the Q4 community fund with the following conditions:

- Credits issued as single-use promo codes tied to individual emails (preferred for auditability).
- Expiration: 120 days from issuance (we can extend if there’s a valid postponement).
- Allowed usage: hosted API and Dedicated sandbox projects. Not allowed: resale or transfer outside of the approved recipient list.
- We’ll require a short one-page MOU (internal template) confirming recipient list and usage policy; operations will keep the promo codes in our system until recipients are verified.

Marissa will own the approval and issuance workflow; Vanessa will coordinate community outreach and recipient verification. Rishi — tagging you for any billing or procurement flags.

Marissa Cole
Director, Partnerships & Community
Redwood Inference

Attachment: none in this reply

On the PO: we do not strictly need a PO for a small community grant, but if OpenGarden prefers one for internal accounting, send the billing contact and we can coordinate a simple invoice or memo.

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Samir Khan <samir@opengarden.dev>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-07T16:48:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: maintainer bounty pool for OpenGarden holiday hackathon

Samir — great news: Marissa approved the $5,000 community promo allocation under the conditions below. We’ve issued individual single-use promo codes for 11 recipients (per your shortlist) that expire 120 days after issuance. Promo codes cover hosted API and Dedicated sandbox usage, and are single-use per recipient email.

I’ve attached a CSV with the assigned promo code IDs and the recipient emails (promo-codes-20261107.csv). If you’d prefer us to hold codes until recipients confirm, let us know — we can do staged release.

Next steps for you:
- Confirm the final recipient email list (copy the recipients in a reply)
- If you need a PO or invoice for accounting, reply with billing contact and tax details

Happy to jump on a 15-min call if you want a quick run-through of how the codes are redeemed. Thanks for running this — excited to support OpenGarden maintainers.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Attachments:
- promo-codes-20261107.csv (CSV stub: code_id,email,issued_at)
